purpose: Teach: バス停/クリーニング/手袋/長編/投げる/スプレー/植木/団子

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、バス停の屋根、新しくなったよ。
lines.en: Mom, the bus-stop roof got a new one.
lines.style: Quick, observant delivery. Excited by noticing something new in the everyday. Bright tone, natural child pace. Slight lift at the end like he's sharing a discovery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。コートのクリーニング、頼んでおいたね。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. I've already sent the coat to dry cleaning.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment without overshadowing his moment. Calm, matter-of-fact. The voice of someone listening while attending to small tasks. Gentle efficiency.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 手袋、洗濯してくれた、ありがとう!
lines.en: Thank you so much for washing my gloves!
lines.style: Genuine gratitude delivered with quick warmth. No performance — just a child's honest thanks. Slightly breathless with sincerity. Natural upward lift on the thanks.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夜、長編アニメ、家族で観ようね。
lines.en: Tonight we'll watch a long anime together as a family, okay?
lines.style: Soft invitation that assumes yes. Warm, inclusive tone. Slight pause before 'together' — like she's looking forward to it. Voice settles at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 運動会、ボール、強く投げるよ!
lines.en: I'm going to throw the ball really hard at the sports day!
lines.style: Eager, full-bodied confidence. Slight breathiness on the 'really hard' — channeling physical excitement into voice. Child's natural energy building toward the moment. Quick pace.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 消毒スプレー、玄関に置いておくね。
lines.en: I'll leave the disinfectant spray by the front door.
lines.style: Simple, practical statement delivered with calm assurance. No fuss. The voice of someone managing details without fanfare. Even pace, grounded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 庭の植木、お父さんが、手入れしてくれてる。
lines.en: Dad's been taking care of the plants in the garden.
lines.style: Quiet observation, slightly admiring. Gentle recognition of his father's work. Soft pace, no urgency. Voice trails slightly — content to notice and leave it at that.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Let's make dango together for moon-viewing.
lines.style: Tender, unhurried invitation. Voice has a gentle smile underneath. Warm finality — the closing of a sweet moment. Slight trailing softness, like she's imagining it already.
